requirement:
三个功能改进：

## 1. Matrix 周视图课表卡片空间利用率优化
当前问题：卡片标题被截断显示为'高等...'，但卡片底部有大量空白空间没利用。
改进：
- 标题允许换行（而非单行截断），充分利用卡片高度显示完整课程名
- 如果显示完标题后仍有空间，且该事件有 location 字段，则在标题下方追加显示位置信息（字体更小、颜色更淡）
- 保持卡片紧凑感，不要因为换行导致其他布局问题

## 2. FAB 浮动按钮可拖动
当前：右下角固定位置的圆形'+'按钮(FAB)
改进：
- FAB 按钮支持手指拖动到屏幕任意位置
- 拖动结束后吸附到最近的屏幕边缘（左/右）
- 记住位置（组件内 state 即可，不需要持久化）
- 拖动时有轻微的透明度变化反馈
- 短按仍然触发原有的新建事件功能，拖动不触发点击

## 3. 新增两个精致主题（保留原有4个主题不变）
新增主题要求：
- 主题5：'Sakura'——樱花粉系，春天气息，温暖柔和
- 主题6：'Ocean'——深海蓝系，冷色调，沉稳专业
- 每个主题需要完整定义所有 theme colors（bg, card, cardBorder, primary, accent, success, danger, warning, textMain, textSub, inputBg, divider 等）
- 关键：不同事件类别（学习、工作、生活等 CATEGORIES）在课表矩阵中要有各自的颜色，但在同一主题下保持色调和谐统一，不要太割裂
- 参考现有主题的 ThemeConfig 结构，确保新主题所有字段齐全
- 课表卡片（EventCard/Matrix 里的）要使用事件类别对应的颜色而非统一的 card 背景色

注意：
- 现有的4个主题（default/dark/nord/solarized 或类似）完全保持不变
- 只新增 Sakura 和 Ocean 两个
- THEME_OPTIONS 数组要同步更新

plan.summary: Deliver the three requested improvements in three sequential phases that align directly with the product scope: first optimize matrix week-view card density and readability with explicit height-based text rules, then make the FAB draggable using React Native's built-in Animated plus PanResponder so no new animation dependency is required, and finally add the two new themes while introducing optional theme tokens and theme-aware category colors for matrix/event cards. This decomposition resolves the prior review issues by merging the thin theme-type work into the theme phase, choosing a concrete drag implementation, defining explicit pixel thresholds from HOUR_HEIGHT=60, and avoiding the existing sakura naming collision by using internal id hanami with user-facing label Sakura 桜 while keeping the original four themes unchanged.

phases.name: Optimize Matrix Card Density
phases.description: Refine the matrix week-view event block content renderer only, without changing the overall positioning math. Add explicit height-based display rules derived from HOUR_HEIGHT=60: events under 40px stay single-line with ellipsis at fontSize 9 and never show location; events from 40px to 80px allow up to 2 title lines at fontSize 10; events above 80px allow wrapped title text and may render a secondary location line below the title only when location exists and there is remaining vertical space after title layout. Keep padding tight so cards feel compact and do not visually spill into adjacent blocks.
acceptance: An event block with rendered height below 40px shows a single-line truncated title, uses the compact typography rule, and does not overflow its container.
An event block with rendered height from 40px to 80px shows up to 2 title lines and remains fully contained within the existing card bounds.
An event block with rendered height above 80px shows wrapped title text, and if the event has a location plus leftover space, renders a smaller, lighter location line below the title.
Event top, height, width, tap behavior, and absolute positioning remain unchanged from the current matrix layout so no neighboring-card collision or grid regression is introduced.
tests: Write a pure helper test for height-to-layout rules that verifies outputs for representative heights such as 30px, 60px, and 90px.
Write a matrix event rendering test with a long title and location that asserts single-line, two-line, and expanded behaviors at the three thresholds.
Write a regression render test ensuring short events remain visually contained and long events do not introduce extra card height or shift block positioning.

phases.name: Add Draggable FAB
phases.description: Replace the fixed-position FAB behavior with a draggable floating control implemented via React Native Animated and PanResponder, explicitly avoiding react-native-reanimated because it is not currently in dependencies. Track FAB position in component state, allow free dragging within screen bounds, reduce opacity slightly during active drag, and on release snap to the nearest left or right edge while preserving the clamped vertical position. Introduce a movement threshold so a short tap still triggers the existing create-event action, but a drag gesture never does.
acceptance: A short tap on the FAB without exceeding the movement threshold triggers the original create-event action exactly once.
Dragging the FAB moves it with the finger across the screen, keeps it inside allowed bounds, and applies a visible but subtle opacity change while dragging.
Releasing the FAB snaps it to the nearest horizontal screen edge and preserves the last valid vertical position.
After a drag completes, the FAB remains at its new position for subsequent renders within the same mounted session and does not reset until the component is recreated.
A drag interaction never triggers the create-event action.
tests: Write a pure helper test for edge-snapping and vertical clamping logic using multiple screen positions.
Write a component interaction test that verifies a tap path calls onPress once and leaves the FAB at its original position.
Write a component interaction test that simulates movement beyond the drag threshold and verifies onPress is not called while snap logic is invoked.

phases.name: Add New Themes And Category Colors
phases.description: Extend the theming system in the same phase that introduces the new theme definitions. Add optional theme tokens needed for the new work, specifically warning as an optional color token so the existing four themes remain unchanged, and optional categoryColors keyed by CategoryKey so theme-specific schedule colors can be defined without forcing legacy backfills. Add two new themes: hanami as the internal id for the new cherry-blossom theme with user-facing label Sakura 桜, and ocean for the deep-blue theme. Each new theme provides a complete color set including warning and categoryColors for every event category. Then switch matrix event blocks and EventCard to resolve category-driven colors through the theme-aware mapping, falling back to the existing CATEGORIES colors for legacy themes so the current four themes continue to behave exactly as before.
acceptance: The existing four themes remain present and unchanged in behavior and source values, with no required backfill of new fields.
THEME_OPTIONS expands from four entries to six entries and includes the new user-facing choices Sakura 桜 and Ocean.
ThemeConfig additions are optional, so legacy themes compile unchanged, while the two new themes define all required visual tokens including warning and a full categoryColors map.
In matrix view and EventCard, event coloring is derived from the event category rather than a uniform card background, and category hues stay distinct yet visually harmonious within each theme.
Legacy themes still render category colors correctly through fallback behavior even if they do not define categoryColors.
tests: Write a theme registry test that verifies getTheme and THEME_OPTIONS expose six total themes and include hanami and ocean.
Write a helper test that verifies theme category-color resolution prefers theme.categoryColors when present and falls back to CATEGORIES colors for legacy themes.
Write render tests for matrix blocks or EventCard under hanami and ocean to confirm category-specific colors are applied and differ by category within the same theme.
Write a compatibility test confirming an existing theme without warning or categoryColors still resolves successfully and renders the schedule components without crashing.
